title: AKGEC UPTAC Admission Physical Reporting Process 2026-27
applicability: Candidates allotted AKGEC through UPTAC 2026 who have frozen their allotted course or branch.
reporting_steps: Report physically to AKGEC according to the UPTAC allotment letter.
Bring original documents and photocopies for verification.
Fill out the institute admission form during physical reporting.
Download, complete by hand, and submit the required forms.
Complete the mandatory online anti-ragging undertaking.
Submit the applicable admission fees and complete college formalities.
notes: Original documents are returned after verification.
Students should retain original documents during the first semester.
Hostel allotment is subject to availability and college decision.
Check the official website for reporting and session updates.
